name: remote-agent-hub
description: Run coding agents on a remote host and drive them from a browser.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @rah/daemon && npm run build -w @rah/web
scripts.test: npm test -w @rah/daemon && npm test -w @rah/web && npm test -w @rah/ext-board && npm test -w @rah/site
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && cd packages/e2e && node --test test/*.spec.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @rah/daemon && npm run typecheck -w @rah/web && npm run typecheck -w @rah/ext-board && npm run typecheck -w @rah/site && npm run typecheck -w @rah/ext-memory
